<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/get_node_files"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the contents of every file belonging to a node: its main.lua
entry point (if present) plus any other loose files found directly in the
node's directory (excluding node_config.json), such as sample data files.
Raises 404 if the node directory or its node_config.json cannot be found.
